I have taught finance, banking and macroeconomics from undergraduate to PhD level at Sabancı, Stockholm, Özyeğin and Boğaziçi universities. In 2026, my students at Stockholm Business School nominated me for the Ballerina Award for Exceptional Pedagogical Ability, which I received.
